title: The Calendar page tells the person the bot WILL NOT join an opted-out meeting, but nothing in the scheduler applies join rules yet: false assurance
area: apps/web/src/pages/calendar/OptOutControl.tsx (confirm text 'The bot will not join this meeting, even if a rule or an approval would otherwise allow it.' and success/loaded text 'Opted out: the bot will not join this meeting.')
evidence: git grep applyJoinRules|evaluateJoinRules|loadJoinRules over scripts/ apps/ packages/ at 4da9db2 and at codex/machine-migration-2026-10-09: non-test callers are only join-rules-select.ts (definition), join-rules-store.ts, join-rules.ts, join-rules-optout.ts and scripts/webinar/join-rules-host.ts (the edit API host). scripts/webinar/run-pipeline.mjs and schedule-tick.ts never call applyJoinRules; TASKS.md T-037 still lists 'scheduler switch-over' as remaining; W3 (invalid-rule-set policy) awaits the Approver. So after the person confirms, the record is stored (verified end to end: state.optedOutEventIds ['calMeet'], optedOutMeetings ['url:meet:abc-defg-hij']) and the scheduler STILL joins the meeting. The page asserts the opposite in two places, in the present tense.
fix_direction: Say what is true while unwired, e.g. confirm: 'This records an opt-out for this meeting (and any meeting using the same link). Join rules are not enforced by the scheduler yet, so this does not stop a join today. Undo is not available in this page.'; success/loaded: 'Opt-out recorded (not enforced by the scheduler yet).' Switch to the enforcing wording only in the wiring unit (W1-W5, Approver for W3). Add a test pinning that the text does not contain 'will not join' while unwired.

title: Opt-out with the URL hint blocks EVERY future occurrence sharing that room link (recurring Meet/Zoom-room series), permanently, with no undo; the confirm text says 'this meeting'
evidence: scripts/qa/calendar-optout-id-space.test.ts test (ii): fake gws returns instance 'series1_20261012T100000Z' (recurringEventId 'series1', hangoutLink https://meet.google.com/xyz-wxyz-abc). The page opts out that instance: body {eventId:'series1_20261012T100000Z', meetingUrl:'https://meet.google.com/xyz-wxyz-abc'} -> stored optedOutMeetings ['url:meet:xyz-wxyz-abc']. A later instance 'series1_20261019T100000Z' (different id, same room) is then vetoed by applyJoinRules (toSchedule.length 0). Meeting identity ignores start time by design (ISS-T037W1-002 accepted it as low for a selection-time sibling match; here it becomes a stored, permanent block). The API does return recurringEventId, but the web UpcomingMeeting type drops it, so the page cannot warn.
fix_direction: Add 'recurringEventId?: string' to the web UpcomingMeeting type and, when set (or always), state in the confirm text that every meeting using the same link will be skipped, and that this cannot be undone from the UI. (Un-opt remains ISS-T037OPT-001.)

title: The page ignores the response: a 200 for a URL the server derives no identity from (e.g. a Zoom webinar REGISTRATION link) is presented exactly like a fully protected opt-out
evidence: scripts/qa/calendar-optout-id-space.test.ts 'hint' test: calendar event 'calReg' with video entry point https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_abcdef -> POST {eventId:'calReg', meetingUrl:'https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_abcdef'} -> 200, state.optedOutMeetings absent (id only). A Gmail copy of that meeting carrying the registration link is NOT vetoed; a Gmail copy carrying the join link https://zoom.us/j/... is not matched either (test (iii) 'registration-link copy is not matched'). The page shows the same 'Opted out' message as for calZoom, where optedOutMeetings ['url:zoom:123456789'] was stored.
fix_direction: Read state.optedOutMeetings from the POST response (the web parseView ignores it) and, when empty after a hinted request, say 'recorded for this calendar entry only; the same meeting from another source may still be recorded'.
